sentences.en: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
sentences.zh: 你是否成功取决于你的努力。

sentences.en: All the efforts of the doctors were of no avail.
sentences.zh: 尽管医生们尽力了，但还是没有效果。

sentences.en: With just a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
sentences.zh: 再加把劲儿，他就能成功了。

senses.zh: 努力，艰难的尝试；力气，精力；有组织的活动；努力的结果，成就；努力的结果，成就

collocations.en: make an effort to do sth
